page.overview:
Who is Red?

Red is the protagonist of the Generation I games and is a highly skilled Pokémon Trainer from Pallet Town, Kanto. He is the first character to be playable in the Pokémon series and his initial appearance is set in the original main games. He has since then made various appearances in Pokémon media, including the Generation III remakes of ; FireRed and LeafGreen. Red became the official Kanto Pokémon League Champion. Red is also a non-playable character in Generation II and their remakes, Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, Sun and Moon, and Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, where he often continues the role of a Pokémon Champion.

He can be fought at Mt. Silver (Gold/Silver, Crystal, HeartGold/SoulSilver) and in the Pokémon Champion Tournament at Pokémon Black 2 and White 2.

His Rival and close friend is Blue, and Leaf is his female counterpart.

In his original appearance, Red has spiky black hair and black eyes. He wears a red and white cap with a black and gold leaf patch and a thin white line along the brim, a red short sleeve jacket with white accents, white sleeves, and white patch pockets over a black t-shirt along with cuffed mid-blue jeans with a black belt and white and red sneakers. He also carries a brown backpack with black straps. He is sometimes depicted wearing black fingerless gloves with white cuffs.
